name: Flawed Power Stone
summary: Deep within the arid expanse of the Barrens, mysterious stones infused with arcane energy rest atop arcane tables. Intentionally fashioned with fatal defects, these volatile relics consume their own power rapidly once separated from their source.

sections.title: Volatile Craftsmanship
sections.body: The flawed power stones found scattered in the Barrens are curious magical anomalies. While undeniably charged with arcane essence, their structure was intentionally compromised during their creation. Whatever hands shaped them ensured that they would remain deeply unstable, decaying into inert matter mere moments after being handled.

sections.title: Self-Consuming Energy
sections.body: Rather than acting as steady reservoirs or catalysts, these stones immediately begin to burn through their contained power the moment they are taken from the ritual tables where they rest. This self-consuming nature prevents anyone from transporting them far, suggesting their creators designed them as temporary conduits or defensive fail-safes.

faq.q: What is a Flawed Power Stone?
faq.answer: A Flawed Power Stone is a volatile object charged with raw magical power. It has been deliberately crafted with flaws that cause it to burn through its energy and consume itself rapidly once moved.
These stones are discovered resting atop specialized tables within the Barrens, where magical experiments and ritual artifacts are periodically maintained.

faq.q: Why were the stones made to be flawed?
faq.answer: Their deliberate instability suggests they were never intended to be carried or used outside their immediate ritual setting. By causing the stones to consume themselves quickly once removed from their tables, their creators prevent outsiders from easily repurposing or studying the unstable magic.

faq.q: Can the stones be preserved permanently?
faq.answer: No. Once detached from the tables where they draw stability, the magical matrices collapse and rapidly exhaust their own energy reserves.
The stones belong to practitioners conducting volatile arcane or ritual work in the Barrens, relying on short-lived infusions rather than permanent enchantments.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about them?
faq.answer: The Horde actively monitors arcane and anomalous threats across their territories in Kalimdor. Investigating volatile power sources in the Barrens ensures that no rival sorcerers or renegade groups can build up dangerous, unchecked weapons near key outposts.

angles.text: The Horde keeps a wary eye on arcane oddities scattered across the Barrens, guarding against rogue sorcery that could threaten their supply routes.
Mages recognize the deliberate structural imperfections in these stones as a volatile fail-safe designed to prevent the theft of raw magical energy.
